jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

A well-established and growing wealth management and investment advisory firm is looking for a Client Administration Officer to join its Brussels office.

An international manufacturing organization is seeking a senior finance leader to support operational performance, profitability enhancement and strategic decision-making across a complex industrial footprint.

This highly visible role combines financial leadership, operational analysis and performance management, while partnering with senior stakeholders to drive sustainable business results.

The successful candidate will operate at the crossroads of finance and operations, providing meaningful insight, challenge and support to business leaders within a dynamic and evolving industrial environment.

Jobomschrijving

Head of Industrial Performance & Controlling 

You will play a central role in monitoring and driving operational performance, helping business leaders translate industrial activities into measurable financial outcomes.

Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will contribute to both short-term performance delivery and long-term value creation initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

• Driving financial and operational performance management across manufacturing activities
• Leading budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes for industrial operations
• Identifying opportunities to improve profitability, productivity and resource allocation
• Analyzing cost structures, operational efficiencies and key performance drivers
• Supporting business leaders through data-driven recommendations and robust financial insights
• Challenging assumptions and influencing decision-making through fact-based analysis
• Developing and enhancing performance management tools, reporting frameworks and financial governance practices
• Supporting investment evaluations, business cases and transformation initiatives
• Monitoring operational risks and ensuring appropriate financial controls are in place
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening business performance
• Collaborating with finance and operational teams across multiple locations and functions.

Head of Industrial Performance & Controlling 

We are looking for a seasoned finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine understanding of industrial operations.

You bring:

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or Business Administration
• Strong leadership skills
• Significant experience in industrial finance, controlling or performance management within a manufacturing environment
• Strong understanding of cost management, profitability analysis and operational performance measurement
• Experience operating in international and matrix organizations
• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and challenge constructively
• Strong business acumen coupled with excellent analytical skills
• Ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Experience supporting operational and strategic decision-making
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Fluency in English with knowledge of French and/or Dutch
• Open to travel occasionally.

jobs.occupation: Statutory & Tax Accountant - Vilvoorde - Construction Company
jobs.description:
Our client is an international corporation and leader in construction. They have multiple sites in Belgium, but maintain a flat structure in their organization.

Jobomschrijving

Statutory Accounting

• Prepare and maintain statutory accounts for legal entities in accordance with Belgian Gaap
• Ensure statutory books and records are accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
• Analyse and reconcile differences between IFRS and local GAAP.
• Coordinate and support external statutory audits.
• Ensure compliance with local company law (e.g. Code of Companies and Associations).

Tax Compliance

• Prepare and submit corporate income tax returns and related filings
• Calculate tax estimation, and prepayment taxes amount over the year
• Monitor and implement new tax legislation affecting the entities
• Support tax audits and interactions with tax authorities
• Other tax-related obligations such as investment deductions, withholding taxes
• Transfer pricing documentation, BEPS / Pillar Two-related reporting

Reporting & Controls

• Ensure statutory and tax deadlines are met in line with group calendars.
• Maintain strong internal controls over accounting and tax processes.
• Prepare statutory data for management, works councils, and group reporting.
• Liaise with business controllers, finance managers, and shared service teams.

Given the complexity of the organization and the challenge of this role we are looking for a candidate with a strong background in accounting and tax. Ideally matching the following criteria:

• min 5 years experience if Chartered Accountant with a tax specialisation
• minimum of 10 years experience if Bachelor's degree in Accounting with tax specialisation
• Fluent in Dutch, French and good command in English
• Knowledge of Belgian Gaap Accounting
• Knowledge of Belgian Corporate Taxes Rules
• Good knowledge of Transfer Price rules
• Understanding of strong internal control principles
• Able to work to tight deadlines and reporting timetables
• SAP knowledge (FI/CO) is an asset
